title: AKS enables the Azure Policy add-on

title: Attached EBS volume is encrypted
frameworks: AWS Audit Manager Control Tower Guardrails
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013

title: Attached EBS volume is deleted on instance termination
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
remediation: Set DeleteOnTermination=true on the instance block-device mapping (ModifyInstanceAttribute) for volumes that hold no data that must outlive the instance.

frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)

frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight

AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013

title: Second-generation Cloud SQL instance has no public (PRIMARY) IP address
frameworks: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v2.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Disable public IPv4 (ipv4Enabled=false) and connect over private IP or the Cloud SQL Auth Proxy.

title: Cloud SQL instance uses a private network address and no public address
remediation: Attach the instance to a private VPC network (private IP) and disable public IPv4.

title: BigQuery dataset access does not grant gmail.com accounts
remediation: Remove dataset access entries for consumer gmail.com accounts and grant access to managed identities.

title: BigQuery dataset access does not grant googlegroups.com accounts
remediation: Remove dataset access entries for consumer googlegroups.com accounts and grant access to managed identities.

title: GKE cluster enforces Binary Authorization
remediation: Enable Binary Authorization (evaluationMode PROJECT_SINGLETON_POLICY_ENFORCE or POLICY_BINDINGS).

title: GKE cluster does not issue legacy client certificates
remediation: Recreate the cluster without issueClientCertificate; use IAM/OIDC authentication instead.

title: GKE cluster does not enable Kubernetes alpha features
remediation: Do not run production workloads on alpha clusters; recreate without enableKubernetesAlpha.

title: GKE HTTP load balancing add-on is enabled
remediation: Enable the HttpLoadBalancing add-on when the cluster uses GKE Ingress.

title: GKE Kubernetes Dashboard add-on is disabled
remediation: Disable the legacy kubernetesDashboard add-on.

title: GKE cluster logging service is enabled
remediation: Enable Cloud Logging for the cluster (loggingService not 'none').

title: GKE cluster monitoring service is enabled
remediation: Enable Cloud Monitoring for the cluster (monitoringService not 'none').

title: GKE cluster does not use the default VPC network
remediation: Create clusters in a purpose-built VPC network instead of the auto-created default network.

title: GKE nodes do not use the Compute Engine default service account
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Run every node pool with a dedicated least-privilege service account.

title: GKE cluster is enrolled in a release channel
remediation: Enroll the cluster in the RAPID, REGULAR, STABLE or EXTENDED release channel.

title: Zonal GKE cluster spans at least three zones
remediation: Use a regional cluster or configure node locations across at least three zones.

title: GKE cluster subnetwork has Private Google Access enabled
remediation: Enable privateIpGoogleAccess on the subnetwork used by the cluster.

title: GKE cluster network has no untargeted firewall rule allowing internet ingress
remediation: Restrict firewall rules on the cluster network to approved sources, or scope them with target tags/service accounts.

title: GKE control plane authorized networks are enabled and exclude 0.0.0.0/0
remediation: Enable master authorized networks with specific CIDR blocks (or use a private endpoint).

title: GKE cluster nodes have private IP addresses only
remediation: Enable private nodes (privateClusterConfig.enablePrivateNodes or networkConfig.defaultEnablePrivateNodes).

title: Pod containers declare cpu limits
remediation: Declare resources.limits.cpu for every regular container (or enforce a LimitRange default).

title: Pod containers declare cpu requests
remediation: Declare resources.requests.cpu for every regular container (or enforce a LimitRange default).

title: Pod containers declare memory limits
remediation: Declare resources.limits.memory for every regular container (or enforce a LimitRange default).

title: Pod containers declare memory requests
remediation: Declare resources.requests.memory for every regular container (or enforce a LimitRange default).

title: Pod containers declare a liveness probe
remediation: Declare a livenessProbe for every long-running regular container.

title: Pod containers declare a readiness probe
remediation: Declare a readinessProbe for every serving regular container.

title: Pod containers do not declare hostPort
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Remove hostPort declarations and publish the workload through a Service.

title: Pod containers do not run as Windows HostProcess
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Remove windowsOptions.hostProcess=true unless the node-management workload is approved.

title: Pod containers do not add Linux capabilities
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Remove capabilities.add entries unless explicitly approved.

title: Pod containers declaring capabilities add none and drop some
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Declare capabilities.drop: [ALL] and add back only approved capabilities.

title: Pod containers do not add NET_RAW
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Remove NET_RAW from capabilities.add.

title: Pod containers do not declare runAsUser 0
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Run containers with a non-zero runAsUser and runAsNonRoot: true.

title: Pod containers do not load Secrets into environment variables
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Mount Secrets as files (or use a CSI secret store) instead of secretKeyRef environment variables.

title: Pod containers do not set credential-like environment variables to literal values
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Move the credential into a Secret (mounted as a file, or a CSI secret store) instead of a literal env value, and rotate it.

title: Pod does not share the host IPC namespace
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Set hostIPC: false (or remove it) unless the workload is an approved node agent.

title: Pod does not share the host PID namespace
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Set hostPID: false (or remove it) unless the workload is an approved node agent.

title: Pod or all of its containers use the RuntimeDefault seccomp profile
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Set securityContext.seccompProfile.type: RuntimeDefault at Pod level (or on every container).

title: cronjob consumes Secrets as files rather than environment variables
remediation: Mount Secrets as volumes instead of env secretKeyRef/envFrom secretRef.

title: cronjob containers do not declare privileged (<1024) container ports
remediation: Listen on unprivileged ports (>=1024) inside containers.

remediation: Run at least three replicas (or an HPA minReplicas of 3) for highly available services.

remediation: Remove Helm v2 Tiller; migrate to Helm 3, which has no in-cluster server component.

title: The kubernetes API Service endpoints serve HTTPS on 443 or 6443
frameworks: Kubernetes NSA and CISA Hardening Guidance v1.0

title: Ingress declares no ingress-nginx snippet annotations
remediation: Remove ingress-nginx *-snippet annotations and set allow-snippet-annotations=false on the controller.

title: Ingress snippet annotations do not use the alias directive
remediation: Remove ingress-nginx *-snippet annotations and set allow-snippet-annotations=false on the controller.

title: Ingress snippet annotations do not embed Lua code

title: PSP permitting hostPath volumes restricts allowedHostPaths

title: PSP enforces SELinux, AppArmor or seccomp defaults

title: PSP sets a default seccomp profile

title: kube-controller-manager sets a non-default terminated-pod GC threshold

title: Kubelet configuration declares an x509 client CA file

frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for Kubernetes
remediation: Confirm each cluster-admin binding is required; replace it with narrower roles where possible.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for project ownership assignments/changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for audit configuration changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for custom role changes (create, delete, update)
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for custom role changes (create, delete, update, undelete)
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for VPC network firewall rule changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for VPC network route changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for VPC network changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for Cloud Storage IAM permission changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: Log metric filter and notifying alert exist for SQL instance configuration changes
remediation: Create a log-based metric whose filter captures every change in the CIS reference filter, and an enabled Cloud Monitoring alert policy with a threshold condition on that metric and at least one enabled notification channel.

title: A log sink exports all log entries of the project
remediation: Create an enabled sink with an empty filter and no active exclusions, preferably an organization-level aggregated sink with includeChildren, exporting to a protected destination.

title: Cloud Function ingress settings do not allow all traffic
remediation: Set the function ingress setting to ALLOW_INTERNAL_ONLY or ALLOW_INTERNAL_AND_GCLB (gcloud functions deploy --ingress-settings=internal-only).

title: Cloud Function is not publicly accessible or invocable
remediation: Remove allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers from the function IAM policy and, for 2nd-gen functions, from the roles/run.invoker binding of the backing Cloud Run service.

title: Cloud Function egress uses a Serverless VPC Access connector
remediation: Attach a Serverless VPC Access connector to the function (gcloud functions deploy --vpc-connector=...).

title: Cloud Run service is not publicly invocable
remediation: Remove allUsers and allAuthenticatedUsers from roles/run.invoker and keep invoker IAM checks enabled (invokerIamDisabled=false) unless the service is intentionally public.

title: API key was created within the last 90 days
frameworks: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v2.0.0
CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.0
CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v4.0.0
CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v5.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for GCP
remediation: Create a replacement API key, move clients to it and delete keys older than 90 days.

title: BigQuery dataset declares a customer-managed default encryption key
frameworks: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v2.0.0
CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v3.0.0
CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v4.0.0
CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v5.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for GCP
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Set defaultEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyName on the dataset (bq update --default_kms_key=...).

title: Cloud SQL instance has only PRIVATE IP address assignments
frameworks: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v2.0.0
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Disable public IPv4 (ipv4Enabled=false), remove outgoing public addresses and connect over private IP.

title: Lambda function environment variables are encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
remediation: Set KMSKeyArn on the function to a customer managed KMS key that encrypts its environment variables.

title: Lambda function Invoke API calls are recorded by a CloudTrail data event selector
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Add a CloudTrail data event selector for AWS::Lambda::Function (all functions or this function ARN).

title: Lambda function resource-based policy does not allow public access
frameworks: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Remove public principals from the function policy or restrict them with aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceArn/aws:PrincipalOrgID conditions.

title: Lambda function URL CORS does not allow the wildcard origin
remediation: Replace the * origin in the function URL CORS AllowOrigins with the specific trusted origins.

title: Lambda function uses only layers owned by the audited account
remediation: Replace layers published by other accounts with layers built and published in this account, or verify the publisher.

title: Lambda function runtime is not in the pinned obsolete runtime list
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
remediation: Upgrade the function to a currently supported Lambda runtime.

title: Host-network ECS task definitions run non-privileged containers as an explicit non-root user
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Avoid host network mode, or set a non-root user on every non-privileged container of the task definition.

title: Every container of the ECS task definition has a log driver configured
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Add a logConfiguration with a logDriver (for example awslogs) to every container definition.

title: ECS container logging uses non-blocking delivery mode
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Set logConfiguration.options.mode to non-blocking (and size max-buffer-size), or leave it unset with the defaultLogDriverMode account setting at non-blocking.

title: ECS containers do not pass AWS credentials as plain environment variables
remediation: Move AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and ECS_ENGINE_AUTH_DATA out of environment into secrets (Secrets Manager / Parameter Store) or use the task IAM role.

title: ECS cluster has Container Insights enabled or enhanced
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Turn on Container Insights (enabled or enhanced) for the cluster.

title: ECS cluster containerInsights setting is turned on
remediation: Turn on Container Insights for the cluster.

title: ECS cluster has at least one active service
remediation: Delete unused clusters or deploy the intended services to them.

title: ECS cluster has at least one registered container instance
remediation: Register container instances to the cluster, or remove the cluster if it is unused (Fargate-only clusters have none by design).

title: Active container instances of the ECS cluster have a connected agent
remediation: Restore connectivity of the ECS container agent (network path, IAM role, agent version) or deregister the instance.

title: EBS volumes of the ECS cluster's container instances are encrypted
remediation: Use encrypted EBS volumes (or enable EBS encryption by default) for the cluster's container instances.

title: ECS container instance runs in a VPC
remediation: Run container instances in a VPC (EC2-Classic is retired).

title: ECS service does not automatically assign public IP addresses
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Set networkConfiguration.awsvpcConfiguration.assignPublicIp to DISABLED and reach the service through a load balancer or NAT.

title: awsvpc-mode ECS service does not automatically assign public IP addresses
remediation: Set networkConfiguration.awsvpcConfiguration.assignPublicIp to DISABLED for the service.

title: ECS Fargate service runs on the latest Fargate platform version
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Update the service to platform version LATEST (or 1.4.0 Linux / 1.0.0 Windows).

title: ECS service is attached to a load balancer
remediation: Attach the service to an Elastic Load Balancing target group when it serves traffic.

title: ECS task set does not automatically assign public IP addresses
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Set the task set awsvpcConfiguration.assignPublicIp to DISABLED.

title: EKS public API endpoint is not open to 0.0.0.0/0
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Disable public endpoint access or restrict publicAccessCidrs to trusted ranges.

title: EKS cluster API endpoint is not publicly accessible
remediation: Disable endpointPublicAccess and use the private endpoint.

title: EKS cluster does not attach multiple additional security groups
remediation: Consolidate the cluster's additional security groups into one reviewed group.

title: EKS cluster Kubernetes version is at least 1.19 (pinned steampipe floor)
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
remediation: Upgrade the cluster to a Kubernetes version in EKS standard support.

title: EKS cluster Kubernetes version is at least 1.28 (prowler default floor)
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Upgrade the cluster to a Kubernetes version in EKS standard support.

title: EKS cluster has deletion protection enabled
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Enable deletionProtection on the cluster (UpdateClusterConfig).

title: EKS cluster has an encryptionConfig (KMS envelope encryption) configured
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Associate a KMS key for secrets envelope encryption (AssociateEncryptionConfig).

title: EKS cluster has a cluster security group
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Recreate legacy clusters so that EKS manages a cluster security group, and review its rules.

title: EKS Amazon VPC CNI managed add-on enforces Kubernetes network policies
remediation: Set enableNetworkPolicy to true in the vpc-cni add-on configurationValues (or document the third-party policy engine in use).

title: Auto Scaling group spans more than one Availability Zone
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Configure the group with subnets in at least two Availability Zones.

title: Auto Scaling group uses an EC2 launch template
remediation: Migrate the group from a launch configuration to an EC2 launch template.

title: Auto Scaling group attached to a load balancer uses ELB health checks
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Set HealthCheckType to ELB on groups attached to load balancers or target groups.

title: Auto Scaling group behind load balancers has Capacity Rebalancing enabled
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Enable CapacityRebalance so Spot capacity is replaced proactively.

title: Auto Scaling group runs at least two instance types in each of several Availability Zones
remediation: Use a mixed instances policy with several instance types across at least two Availability Zones.

title: Auto Scaling group mixed instances policy overrides more than one instance type
remediation: Add several instance types to the mixed instances policy overrides.

title: Auto Scaling group has no suspended scaling processes
remediation: Resume suspended processes (ResumeProcesses) once maintenance is complete.

title: Auto Scaling group tags propagate to launched EC2 instances
frameworks: AWS CIS Compute Services Benchmark v1.0.0
remediation: Set PropagateAtLaunch true on the group's tags.

title: Auto Scaling group launch configuration does not assign public IP addresses
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Use a launch template or configuration with AssociatePublicIpAddress false.

title: Auto Scaling group launch configuration requires IMDSv2 or disables the metadata service
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set MetadataOptions HttpTokens required (or HttpEndpoint disabled) in the group's launch template/configuration.

title: Launch configuration does not associate public IP addresses
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Create a replacement launch configuration/template with AssociatePublicIpAddress false.

title: Launch configuration requires IMDSv2 (HttpTokens required)
remediation: Create a replacement launch configuration/template with MetadataOptions HttpTokens required.

title: Launch configuration metadata response hop limit is not greater than 1
remediation: Use HttpPutResponseHopLimit 1 in the launch configuration/template.

title: AppStream fleet default internet access is disabled
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Disable default internet access and route fleet traffic through a NAT gateway with controlled egress.

title: AppStream fleet maximum user session duration is under 10 hours
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Set MaxUserDurationInSeconds below 36000.

title: AppStream fleet disconnect timeout is 5 minutes or less
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Set DisconnectTimeoutInSeconds to 300 or less.

title: AppStream fleet idle disconnect timeout is enabled and 10 minutes or less
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Set IdleDisconnectTimeoutInSeconds between 60 and 600.

title: Elastic Beanstalk environment streams instance logs to CloudWatch Logs
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS CIS Compute Services Benchmark v1.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set aws:elasticbeanstalk:cloudwatch:logs StreamLogs to true.

title: Elastic Beanstalk environment has managed platform updates enabled
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set aws:elasticbeanstalk:managedactions ManagedActionsEnabled to true and configure a maintenance window.

title: Elastic Beanstalk environment uses enhanced health reporting
frameworks: AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Set aws:elasticbeanstalk:healthreporting:system SystemType to enhanced.

title: CloudFront distribution does not use the default CloudFront certificate
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Attach a custom ACM (us-east-1) or IAM certificate for the distribution's alternate domain names instead of the default *.cloudfront.net certificate.

title: CloudFront default cache behavior redirects to or requires HTTPS
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set the default cache behavior ViewerProtocolPolicy to redirect-to-https or https-only.

title: CloudFront distribution with a custom certificate serves HTTPS via SNI only
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set ViewerCertificate.SSLSupportMethod to sni-only (dedicated-IP 'vip' is only needed for legacy clients without SNI).

title: CloudFront distribution has standard, real-time or v2 (CloudWatch Logs delivery) logging
frameworks: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Enable standard logging (legacy S3 or v2 CloudWatch Logs delivery) or attach a real-time log configuration to the distribution.

title: CloudFront origin traffic is encrypted for S3 and custom origins
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Use https-only for custom origins (or match-viewer with HTTPS-only viewers) and do not allow plain HTTP viewers in front of S3 origins.

title: CloudFront viewer certificate enforces a post-quantum TLS security policy
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Use a custom certificate and set MinimumProtocolVersion to TLSv1.3_2025.

title: CloudFront S3 origins use origin access control (OAC)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Create an origin access control, set OriginAccessControlId on every S3 origin and restrict the bucket policy to the distribution.

title: CloudFront S3 origins point to existing buckets
remediation: Recreate the bucket in an account you own or repoint/remove the origin so the bucket name cannot be claimed by someone else.

title: CloudFront custom origins do not allow SSLv3, TLSv1 or TLSv1.1
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Restrict every custom origin's OriginSslProtocols to TLSv1.2.

title: CloudFront s3.amazonaws.com origins declare an origin access identity
remediation: Restrict S3 origins to CloudFront (prefer origin access control; an OAI satisfies this control).

title: CloudFront viewer certificate uses the recommended TLS security policy
remediation: Use a custom certificate and set MinimumProtocolVersion to TLSv1.2_2021.

title: Network/gateway load balancer enables cross-zone load balancing
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Set the load_balancing.cross_zone.enabled attribute to true.

title: ELBv2 HTTPS listeners use a secure TLS security policy
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Move every HTTPS listener to a TLS 1.2+ policy such as ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Res-PQ-2025-09.

title: Internet-facing ELBv2 security groups do not allow all TCP traffic from anywhere
frameworks: Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Make the load balancer internal or restrict its security groups to the ports and sources it serves.

title: ELBv2 HTTPS/TLS listeners use FIPS security policies
remediation: Use a FIPS security policy (for example ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Res-FIPS-PQ-2025-09) on every HTTPS/TLS listener.

title: ELBv2 HTTPS/TLS listeners use post-quantum TLS security policies
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Use a 2025-09 PQ security policy such as ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Res-PQ-2025-09 on every HTTPS/TLS listener.

title: ELBv2 load balancer has at least one listener
remediation: Add a listener or delete the unused load balancer.

title: Network load balancer terminates TLS on at least one listener
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Add a TLS listener with an ACM certificate to the network load balancer.

title: ALB HTTP listeners redirect to HTTPS (default action or listener rule)
frameworks: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Replace plain HTTP forwarding with a redirect action to HTTPS on every HTTP listener.

title: ALB is associated with a WAFv2 or WAF Classic regional web ACL
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Associate an AWS WAF web ACL with the application load balancer.

title: ALB is associated with a WAFv2 web ACL
remediation: Associate an AWS WAFv2 web ACL with the application load balancer.

title: Application/network load balancer is not internet-facing
remediation: Use an internal scheme unless the load balancer must serve the internet; front public ones with WAF and restrictive security groups.

title: ELB listener certificates are valid for at least 30 more days
remediation: Renew or replace the listener certificate (prefer ACM-issued certificates with managed renewal).

title: ELB listener certificates are valid for at least 7 more days
remediation: Renew or replace the listener certificate (prefer ACM-issued certificates with managed renewal).

title: ALB HTTP listeners redirect to HTTPS in their default action
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Set the default action of every ALB HTTP listener to a redirect to HTTPS.

title: ALB security groups all have outbound rules
remediation: Attach a security group with outbound rules to the targets/health-check ports.

title: ALB HTTPS and NLB TLS listeners use a recommended TLS 1.3 security policy
remediation: Set the listener SslPolicy to one of ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06, ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-FIPS-2023-04, ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-3-2021-06, ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-3-FIPS-2023-04, ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Res-2021-06, ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-Res-FIPS-2023-04.

title: Every ALB/NLB listener uses an ACM certificate
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Terminate TLS on every listener with an ACM certificate (replace HTTP/TCP listeners with HTTPS/TLS).

title: ALB listeners use HTTPS and NLB listeners use TLS
remediation: Use HTTPS listeners on application load balancers and TLS listeners on network load balancers.

title: Classic ELB listeners use HTTPS or SSL only
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Replace HTTP/TCP listeners with HTTPS/SSL listeners.

title: Classic ELB HTTPS listeners use ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01
remediation: Attach the predefined ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01 policy to every HTTPS listener.

title: Classic ELB is not internet-facing
remediation: Use an internal Classic ELB or migrate to an internal ALB/NLB.

title: Classic ELB HTTPS/SSL listeners use Amazon-issued ACM certificates
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Issue the certificate through ACM and attach it to the HTTPS/SSL listeners.

title: Classic ELB has registered instances
remediation: Register instances or delete the unused Classic ELB.

title: Classic ELB security groups all have inbound rules
remediation: Attach security groups with the inbound rules the listeners and health checks need.

title: Classic ELB security groups all have outbound rules
remediation: Attach security groups with the outbound rules the listeners and health checks need.

title: API Gateway custom domain enforces a post-quantum TLS security policy
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Set the custom domain securityPolicy to a 2025-09 PQ policy such as SecurityPolicy_TLS13_1_2_PQ_2025_09.

title: REST API has an authorizer or every non-OPTIONS method requires authorization
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Attach a Lambda or Cognito authorizer, or require IAM/custom authorization on every method.

title: REST API stage with caching encrypts cached data
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Enable cacheDataEncrypted on the stage's method settings that enable caching.

title: REST API stage has execution logging on some method setting
frameworks: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Set loggingLevel to ERROR or INFO in the stage method settings.

title: REST API endpoint type is PRIVATE only
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Use a PRIVATE endpoint reachable through an interface VPC endpoint when the API must not be internet-facing.

title: Public REST API has an authorizer
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Attach a Lambda or Cognito authorizer to the public API (or make it PRIVATE).

title: REST API has at least one authorizer
remediation: Attach a Lambda or Cognito authorizer to the API.

title: REST API methods all declare an authorization type other than NONE
remediation: Set authorizationType to AWS_IAM, CUSTOM or COGNITO_USER_POOLS on each method.

title: REST API methods all have a request validator
remediation: Attach a request validator that validates parameters (and body) to each method.

title: REST API resource policy does not allow unrestricted public invocation
remediation: Restrict the resource policy principal or add an aws:SourceAccount/aws:PrincipalOrgID/aws:SourceArn condition.

title: API Gateway v2 API has at least one authorizer
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Attach a JWT or Lambda authorizer to the API.

title: API Gateway v2 routes all specify an authorization type
remediation: Set AuthorizationType to AWS_IAM, CUSTOM or JWT on every route.

title: API Gateway v2 routes all reference an authorizer
remediation: Attach a JWT or Lambda authorizer to each route.

title: AppSync GraphQL API logs resolver fields at ERROR or ALL
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set logConfig.fieldLogLevel to ERROR or ALL.

title: AppSync GraphQL API does not use API_KEY default authentication
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Use AWS_IAM, Cognito user pools, OIDC or Lambda authorization instead of API keys.

title: AppSync API default authentication is not API_KEY
remediation: Use AWS_IAM, Cognito user pools, OIDC or Lambda authorization instead of API keys.

title: AppSync API cache is encrypted at rest
remediation: Recreate the API cache with atRestEncryptionEnabled set to true.

title: AppSync API cache is encrypted in transit
remediation: Recreate the API cache with transitEncryptionEnabled set to true.

title: Direct Connect has at least two connections in different locations
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Provision a second Direct Connect connection at a different location.

title: Each virtual/Direct Connect gateway has at least two virtual interfaces on distinct connections
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Add a second virtual interface on a different connection for every gateway.

title: Athena workgroup query results are encrypted at rest
remediation: Enable query result encryption (SSE_S3, SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS) or managed query results on the Athena workgroup.

title: Enabled Athena workgroup encrypts query results
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Configure ResultConfiguration.EncryptionConfiguration (SSE_S3, SSE_KMS or CSE_KMS) on the Athena workgroup.

title: Athena workgroup enforces its configuration
remediation: Enable EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration so workgroup settings override client-side settings.

title: Enabled Athena workgroup enforces its configuration
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Enable EnforceWorkGroupConfiguration so workgroup settings override client-side settings.

title: Athena workgroup publishes CloudWatch metrics
remediation: Enable PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled on the Athena workgroup.

title: Enabled Athena workgroup publishes CloudWatch metrics
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable PublishCloudWatchMetricsEnabled on the Athena workgroup.

title: Region with backup vaults has at least one backup plan
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Create an AWS Backup plan that assigns the resources to protect.

title: Region with backup plans has a backup report plan
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Create an AWS Backup report plan (for example BACKUP_JOB_REPORT) for the region.

title: Backup vault has an encryption key
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Create backup vaults with a KMS encryption key (recovery points of a vault inherit its key).

title: Backup recovery point is encrypted
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Store recovery points in a vault with a KMS key; copy unencrypted recovery points into an encrypted vault.

title: Backup recovery point is retained at least 35 days
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Set the recovery point lifecycle DeleteAfterDays to 35 or more, or leave it unset (never expires).

title: Backup plan rules retain recovery points at least 35 days
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Set DeleteAfterDays of every backup rule lifecycle to 35 or more, or remove the expiration.

title: Backup vault policy denies manual recovery point deletion
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Add a vault access policy Deny statement on backup:DeleteRecoveryPoint, backup:UpdateRecoveryPointLifecycle and backup:PutBackupVaultAccessPolicy for Resource "*" (or use AWS Backup Vault Lock).

title: Backup vault access policy does not allow public access
remediation: Remove Allow statements with a wildcard principal from the backup vault access policy, or restrict them with conditions.

title: DynamoDB table is an AWS Backup protected resource
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
remediation: Protect the DynamoDB table with an AWS Backup plan so recovery points exist.

title: EFS file system is an AWS Backup protected resource
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
remediation: Protect the EFS file system with an AWS Backup plan (or enable EFS automatic backups).

title: DynamoDB table is selected by an AWS Backup plan
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Add the table ARN (or a dynamodb table wildcard) to an AWS Backup plan resource selection.

title: DynamoDB table is in a backup selection by ARN or tag key
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Assign the table to an AWS Backup plan selection by ARN or by a tag condition.

title: DataSync task has a CloudWatch log group
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Configure a CloudWatch log group on the DataSync task.

title: DataSync task logs to CloudWatch at BASIC or TRANSFER level
remediation: Configure a CloudWatch log group and set Options.LogLevel to BASIC or TRANSFER on the DataSync task.

title: DAX cluster encrypts data at rest
frameworks: AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Create the DAX cluster with server-side encryption enabled (it cannot be enabled on an existing cluster).

title: DAX cluster endpoint uses TLS
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Create the DAX cluster with ClusterEndpointEncryptionType TLS.

title: DAX cluster nodes span more than one Availability Zone
remediation: Add DAX nodes in at least two Availability Zones.

title: Region with EBS snapshots has a DLM lifecycle policy
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager EBS snapshot policy in every region that holds EBS snapshots.

title: Region with EBS snapshots has a DLM EBS snapshot policy
remediation: Create an Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager EBS snapshot policy in every region that holds EBS snapshots.

title: DMS endpoint does not use SslMode none
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set the DMS endpoint SslMode to require, verify-ca or verify-full.

title: DMS MongoDB endpoint uses authentication
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Set MongoDbSettings.AuthType to password on the DMS MongoDB endpoint.

title: DMS Neptune endpoint uses IAM authorization
remediation: Enable NeptuneSettings.IamAuthEnabled on the DMS Neptune endpoint.

title: DMS Redis endpoint uses ssl-encryption
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set RedisSettings.SslSecurityProtocol to ssl-encryption on the DMS Redis endpoint.

title: DMS replication task logs SOURCE_CAPTURE and SOURCE_UNLOAD at default severity or higher
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable task logging and set SOURCE_CAPTURE and SOURCE_UNLOAD to LOGGER_SEVERITY_DEFAULT or more verbose.

title: DMS replication task logs TARGET_APPLY and TARGET_LOAD at default severity or higher
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Enable task logging and set TARGET_APPLY and TARGET_LOAD to LOGGER_SEVERITY_DEFAULT or more verbose.

title: DMS certificate is not expired
remediation: Delete expired DMS certificates and import valid ones for the endpoints that need them.

title: Publicly accessible DMS instance is not open to the Internet by its security groups
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Disable PubliclyAccessible on the replication instance or remove 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0 ingress from its security groups.

title: DocumentDB cluster parameter group requires TLS 1.2 or later
remediation: Set the tls parameter of the DocumentDB cluster parameter group to tls1.2+, tls1.3+ or fips-140-3.

title: DocumentDB instance storage is encrypted
remediation: Create DocumentDB clusters with storage encryption; restore an encrypted snapshot copy to encrypt an existing cluster.

title: DocumentDB cluster snapshot restore attribute is not exactly ["all"]
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
remediation: Remove 'all' from the DocumentDB snapshot restore attribute (ModifyDBClusterSnapshotAttribute ValuesToRemove=all).

title: DocumentDB cluster snapshot is not publicly shared
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Remove 'all' from the DocumentDB snapshot restore attribute.

title: DocumentDB cluster retains automated backups at least 7 days
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set the DocumentDB cluster BackupRetentionPeriod to 7 days or more.

title: DocumentDB cluster exports audit and profiler logs to CloudWatch
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Enable the audit and profiler CloudWatch log exports on the DocumentDB cluster (and audit_logs / profiler parameters).

title: DocumentDB cluster has deletion protection
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Enable DeletionProtection on the DocumentDB cluster.

title: DocumentDB cluster has instances in multiple Availability Zones
remediation: Add a replica instance in another Availability Zone to the DocumentDB cluster.

title: DocumentDB cluster storage is encrypted
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Create DocumentDB clusters with storage encryption; restore an encrypted snapshot copy to encrypt an existing cluster.

title: Region has at least one Elastic Disaster Recovery job
frameworks: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Initialize AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery and replicate the servers that need recovery in this region.

title: Provisioned DynamoDB table auto scales read and write capacity
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Use on-demand capacity or register read and write capacity scalable targets for the table with Application Auto Scaling.

title: DynamoDB table is encrypted with a KMS key
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Switch the table encryption to an AWS managed or customer managed KMS key (SSESpecification SSEType KMS).

title: DynamoDB table resource policy does not allow other accounts
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Remove other-account and wildcard principals from the table resource policy, or restrict them with conditions.

title: ElastiCache cluster does not use public subnets
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Place the cache cluster in a subnet group whose subnets have no default route to an internet (or NAT) gateway.

title: ElastiCache cluster has no subnet routed to an internet or NAT gateway
remediation: Place the cache cluster in a subnet group whose subnets have no default route to an internet (or NAT) gateway.

title: ElastiCache cluster does not use the default subnet group
remediation: Create a dedicated cache subnet group and recreate or migrate the cluster into it.

title: ElastiCache replication group auto-applies minor version upgrades
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Enable AutoMinorVersionUpgrade on the replication group.

title: ElastiCache replication group has Multi-AZ enabled
remediation: Enable Multi-AZ (requires automatic failover) on the replication group.

title: ElastiCache replication group retains snapshots at least 7 days
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Set SnapshotRetentionLimit to 7 days or more on the replication group.

title: ElastiCache replication group retains snapshots at least 15 days
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Set SnapshotRetentionLimit to 15 days or more on the replication group.

title: ElastiCache replication group older than 6.0 uses Redis AUTH
remediation: Enable an AUTH token on replication groups running Redis before 6.0, or upgrade to 6.0+ and use RBAC user groups.

title: ElastiCache replication group is encrypted at rest with an enabled KMS key
remediation: Create the replication group with at-rest encryption and a KMS key (KmsKeyId), and keep that key enabled.

title: EFS file system backup policy is not disabled
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Enable automatic backups for the file system (PutBackupPolicy Status=ENABLED) or protect it with an AWS Backup plan.

title: EFS file system automatic backups are enabled
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Enable automatic backups for the file system (PutBackupPolicy Status=ENABLED).

title: EFS file system policy does not grant access to any client within the VPC
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Attach a file system policy that grants access only to specific principals, or that requires elasticfilesystem:AccessedViaMountTarget.

title: EFS file system policy denies requests without TLS
remediation: Add a Deny statement for Principal * when aws:SecureTransport is false to the file system policy.

title: EFS file system policy has no Allow statement for a wildcard principal
remediation: Replace wildcard principals in the file system policy with specific accounts or roles.

title: EFS file system policy does not allow public access (perimeter)
remediation: Remove wildcard principals or add restricting conditions (aws:SourceAccount, aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:PrincipalArn, ...) to the file system policy.

title: EFS file system is Regional (Multi-AZ) with more than one mount target
remediation: Use a Regional (Multi-AZ) file system with mount targets in at least two Availability Zones.

title: EFS file system has no mount targets in public subnets
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Move mount targets to private subnets (no 0.0.0.0/0 route to an internet gateway).

title: EFS mount target subnet does not auto-assign public IPv4 addresses
remediation: Create mount targets in subnets with MapPublicIpOnLaunch disabled.

title: EFS access point enforces a non-root directory
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Recreate the access point with a RootDirectory.Path other than '/'.

title: EFS access point enforces a POSIX user identity
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Recreate the access point with a PosixUser (Uid/Gid).

title: EFS file system has no access point exposing the root directory
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Recreate access points that use '/' with a dedicated root directory.

title: EFS file system access points all define a POSIX user
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Recreate access points without a PosixUser with an enforced Uid/Gid.

title: EMR cluster security configuration enables encryption at rest
remediation: Launch the cluster with a security configuration that enables at-rest encryption.

title: EMR cluster S3 at-rest encryption uses client-side encryption with a custom key (CSE-Custom)
remediation: Use a security configuration with S3EncryptionConfiguration EncryptionMode CSE-Custom.

title: EMR cluster S3 at-rest encryption uses SSE-KMS
remediation: Use a security configuration with S3EncryptionConfiguration EncryptionMode SSE-KMS.

title: EMR cluster security configuration enables encryption in transit
remediation: Launch the cluster with a security configuration that enables in-transit encryption.

title: EMR cluster local disks are encrypted with a custom key provider
remediation: Configure LocalDiskEncryptionConfiguration with EncryptionKeyProviderType Custom (or AwsKms with your key as required).

title: EMR cluster local disk encryption is enabled
remediation: Enable at-rest encryption with a LocalDiskEncryptionConfiguration in the cluster security configuration.

title: EMR cluster uses Kerberos authentication
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Launch the cluster with a security configuration that enables Kerberos authentication.

title: EMR cluster has a security configuration
remediation: Launch the cluster with an EMR security configuration.

title: EMR security configuration enables encryption at rest
remediation: Enable at-rest encryption in the security configuration (create a new configuration; they are immutable).

title: EMR security configuration enables encryption in transit
remediation: Enable in-transit encryption in the security configuration (create a new configuration; they are immutable).

title: Running EMR cluster primary node subnet does not auto-assign public IPs
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Launch clusters in private subnets with MapPublicIpOnLaunch disabled.

title: EMR cluster primary node has no public DNS name
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Launch the cluster in a private subnet without public IP addressing.

title: Public EMR cluster has no security group open to the internet
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Remove all-traffic ingress rules from public CIDRs on the primary and core/task security groups, or move the cluster to a private subnet.

title: EMR block public access is enabled in the region
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Enable EMR block public access (PutBlockPublicAccessConfiguration BlockPublicSecurityGroupRules=true).

title: EMR block public access is enabled with no port exception other than 22
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
remediation: Enable EMR block public access and remove every permitted port range other than 22.

title: Elasticsearch domain publishes audit logs to a CloudWatch log group
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
remediation: Enable AUDIT_LOGS publishing to a CloudWatch Logs log group (requires fine-grained access control).

title: Elasticsearch domain publishes error logs to a CloudWatch log group
remediation: Enable ES_APPLICATION_LOGS publishing to a CloudWatch Logs log group.

title: Elasticsearch domain publishes error, search slow and index slow logs to CloudWatch
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Enable ES_APPLICATION_LOGS, SEARCH_SLOW_LOGS and INDEX_SLOW_LOGS publishing to CloudWatch Logs log groups.

title: Elasticsearch domain endpoint requires TLS 1.2
remediation: Set DomainEndpointOptions.TLSSecurityPolicy to Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-PFS-2023-10 (or Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-2019-07).

title: Elasticsearch domain is deployed in a VPC
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
AWS Reserve Bank of India - Information Technology Framework for Non-Banking Financial Companies (RBI ITF-NBFC)
remediation: Create the domain inside a VPC and migrate the data (a public domain cannot be moved into a VPC).

title: Elasticsearch domain has the internal user database enabled
remediation: Enable fine-grained access control with the internal user database if the source policy requires it.

title: Elasticsearch domain access policy does not allow public access (perimeter)
remediation: Remove wildcard principals or add restricting conditions (aws:SourceAccount, aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:PrincipalArn, ...) to the domain access policy.

title: Firehose stream is encrypted at rest (or reads from MSK)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Enable server-side encryption on the delivery stream (StartDeliveryStreamEncryption).

title: DB cluster snapshot is encrypted (all engines)
frameworks: AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
remediation: Copy the cluster snapshot with KMS encryption and delete the unencrypted snapshot.

title: DB instance snapshot is encrypted
frameworks: AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
remediation: Copy the DB snapshot with KMS encryption and delete the unencrypted snapshot.

title: In-use ACM certificate expires in more than 7 days
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-171 Revision 2
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 4
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) 800-53 Revision 5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v1.1
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Cyber Security Framework
remediation: Renew or re-import the certificate, or enable ACM managed renewal, before it expires.

title: In-use ACM certificate is imported or has Certificate Transparency logging enabled
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable Certificate Transparency logging (UpdateCertificateOptions) for ACM-issued certificates.

title: In-use ACM certificate does not use an insecure key algorithm (RSA-1024, P-192)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Reissue the certificate with RSA 2048 or stronger, or an ECDSA P-256/P-384 key.

title: AWS Private CA root certificate authority is disabled
remediation: Disable the root CA (UpdateCertificateAuthority Status=DISABLED) and keep it offline; issue from subordinate CAs.

title: AWS Private CA uses a post-quantum (ML-DSA) key algorithm
remediation: Create a replacement CA with an ML-DSA key algorithm and migrate issuance to it.

title: Every Cognito user pool app client prevents user existence errors
remediation: Set PreventUserExistenceErrors to ENABLED on every app client.

title: Every Cognito user pool app client has token revocation enabled
remediation: Set EnableTokenRevocation to true on every app client.

title: Cognito user pool is associated with a WAF web ACL
remediation: Associate a regional AWS WAF web ACL with the user pool.

title: Amazon Connect instance has contact flow logs (CloudWatch) enabled
remediation: Enable contact flow logs on the instance (UpdateInstanceAttribute CONTACTFLOW_LOGS=true).

title: Directory Service directory has SNS event topic notifications
remediation: Register an SNS topic for directory status notifications (RegisterEventTopic).

title: Directory Service directory forwards security logs to CloudWatch Logs
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Create a log subscription that forwards directory security logs to CloudWatch Logs (CreateLogSubscription).

title: Directory Service directory has more than 2 manual snapshots of quota remaining
remediation: Delete obsolete manual snapshots so that more than two manual snapshots remain available.

title: Directory Service LDAPS certificates expire in more than 90 days (Prowler)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Register a renewed LDAPS certificate before the current one expires.

title: Directory Service certificates do not expire within 90 calendar days (steampipe)
remediation: Register a renewed certificate before the current one is within 90 days of expiry.

title: Directory Service RADIUS server uses MS-CHAPv2
remediation: Configure the RADIUS settings with AuthenticationProtocol MS-CHAPv2.

title: Directory Service directory has RADIUS-based MFA enabled
frameworks: ASD Essential Eight Maturity Model - Maturity Level One (AWS)
Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable multi-factor authentication with a RADIUS server for the directory (EnableRadius).

title: Directory Service directory is not shared with accounts outside a trusted list
remediation: Unshare the directory from any account that is not trusted (UnshareDirectory).

title: All AWS Firewall Manager policies are compliant for every member account
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Remediate the non-compliant member accounts or resources (or enable automatic remediation) for each FMS policy.

title: Bedrock guardrail prompt attack filter strength is HIGH
remediation: Configure the guardrail content policy PROMPT_ATTACK filter with inputStrength HIGH.

title: Bedrock guardrail blocks or masks sensitive information
remediation: Add a sensitive information policy (PII entities or regexes with BLOCK/ANONYMIZE) to the guardrail.

title: Bedrock guardrail blocks ungrounded and irrelevant responses
remediation: Configure GROUNDING and RELEVANCE contextual grounding filters, enabled, with action BLOCK and a threshold above 0.

title: At least one Amazon Bedrock guardrail is configured in the region
remediation: Create a Bedrock guardrail (CreateGuardrail) and apply it to model invocations and agents.

title: Amazon Bedrock agent uses a guardrail
remediation: Associate a guardrail with the agent (UpdateAgent guardrailConfiguration).

title: Bedrock custom model is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
remediation: Re-create the custom model (customization job) with a customer managed customModelKmsKeyId.

title: Bedrock prompt is encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Set customerEncryptionKeyArn (a customer managed KMS key) on the prompt.

title: Bedrock knowledge base data sources are encrypted with a customer managed KMS key
remediation: Set serverSideEncryptionConfiguration.kmsKeyArn (customer managed key) on every knowledge base data source.

title: Amazon Bedrock model invocation logging is enabled in the region
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable model invocation logging to CloudWatch Logs and/or S3 (PutModelInvocationLoggingConfiguration).
