title: Bedrock model invocation logs are encrypted in S3 and KMS-encrypted in CloudWatch Logs
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable default encryption on the destination bucket and associate a KMS key with the destination log group.

title: Amazon Bedrock Prompt Management prompts exist in the region
remediation: Manage production prompts with Bedrock Prompt Management (CreatePrompt) for versioning and review.

title: In-use VPC in a Bedrock-active region has interface endpoints for all Bedrock APIs
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Create interface VPC endpoints for bedrock, bedrock-runtime, bedrock-agent, bedrock-agent-runtime and bedrock-mantle in the VPC.

title: Non-service IAM role does not have AmazonBedrockFullAccess attached
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Detach AmazonBedrockFullAccess and grant scoped Bedrock permissions.

title: Amazon Bedrock long-term API key has expired
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Delete long-term Bedrock API keys and use short-term (session-scoped) Bedrock API keys.

title: CodeBuild project visibility is private
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Set the project visibility to PRIVATE so build results, logs and artifacts are not publicly readable.

title: CodeBuild project S3 logs, when enabled, are encrypted
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Re-enable encryption of the project's S3 build logs (clear encryptionDisabled).

title: CodeBuild Bitbucket source repository URLs do not contain credentials
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v3.2.1
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Remove tokens or user name/password from Bitbucket source URLs and connect the source with OAuth or CodeConnections.

title: CodeBuild project does not use a repository buildspec file (.yml/.yaml)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Define the buildspec inline in the project or load it from a location that build authors cannot modify.

title: CodeBuild project buildspec is not a .yml file reference
remediation: Define the buildspec inline in the project or load it from a location that build authors cannot modify.

title: CodeBuild webhook ACTOR_ACCOUNT_ID/HEAD_REF/BASE_REF filters use anchored patterns
remediation: Anchor every alternative of ACTOR_ACCOUNT_ID, HEAD_REF and BASE_REF webhook filter patterns with ^ and $.

title: CodeBuild project has no PLAINTEXT environment variables named like AWS keys or passwords
frameworks: AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
remediation: Move AWS keys and passwords out of PLAINTEXT environment variables into Secrets Manager or Parameter Store references.

title: CodeBuild GitHub or Bitbucket source uses OAuth source credentials
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
AWS Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC)
AWS HIPAA Final Omnibus Security Rule 2013
remediation: Connect GitHub/Bitbucket sources with OAuth (or CodeConnections) instead of personal access tokens or basic authentication.

title: CodeBuild project has been invoked in the last 90 days (prowler)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Delete unused CodeBuild projects (and their service roles) or confirm they are still required.

title: CodeBuild project has a build finished less than 90 days ago (steampipe)
remediation: Delete unused CodeBuild projects (and their service roles) or confirm they are still required.

title: CodeBuild report group S3 exports are encrypted at rest
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
remediation: Enable encryption for the report group's S3 export (clear encryptionDisabled, optionally set a KMS key).

title: CloudFormation stack has not drifted from its template
remediation: Run drift detection and reconcile drifted resources with the stack template (update the stack or the resources).

title: CloudFormation stack sends events to an SNS topic
remediation: Configure an SNS notification topic for the stack (NotificationARNs).

title: CloudFormation stack keeps rollback on failure enabled
remediation: Recreate or update the stack without --disable-rollback so failed operations roll back.

title: CloudFormation stack termination protection is enabled (all stacks)
remediation: Enable termination protection on the stack (on the root stack for nested stacks).

title: CloudFormation root stack termination protection is enabled
remediation: Enable termination protection on the stack.

title: CDKToolkit stack bootstrap version is 21 or higher
remediation: Re-bootstrap the environment with a current AWS CDK version (cdk bootstrap) to reach bootstrap version 21 or later.

title: CodeDeploy Lambda deployment group does not shift all traffic at once
remediation: Use a canary or linear deployment configuration for Lambda deployment groups.

title: ECR repository policy has no Allow statement for a wildcard AWS principal
remediation: Remove the wildcard principal from the repository policy and grant pull/push only to named accounts or roles.

title: ECR repository policy does not allow public access (prowler)
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Remove public principals from the repository policy or restrict them with account or organization conditions.

title: ECR repository policy does not allow public access (perimeter)
remediation: Remove wildcard principals or add restricting conditions (source account, organization, principal ARN) to the repository policy.

title: In-use ECR registry has enhanced scanning enabled
remediation: Switch the registry scanning configuration to ENHANCED (Amazon Inspector) scanning.

title: In-use ECR registry scans all repositories automatically
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Add a registry scanning rule with SCAN_ON_PUSH or CONTINUOUS_SCAN frequency and a '*' repository filter.

title: ECR repository latest scannable image is scanned without MEDIUM or higher findings
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
remediation: Rebuild and push the image with patched packages, then confirm the new scan has no MEDIUM, HIGH or CRITICAL findings.

title: EventBridge custom event bus has a resource-based policy attached
frameworks: AWS Australian Cyber Security Center (ACSC) Essential Eight
remediation: Attach a resource-based policy to the custom event bus that limits which principals can put events.

title: EventBridge event bus policy does not allow public access
frameworks: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark v7.0.0
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
Prowler ThreatScore Compliance Framework for AWS
remediation: Remove the wildcard principal from the event bus policy or restrict it with organization or account conditions.

title: EventBridge event bus policy does not allow cross-account access
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Limit the event bus policy to principals of the audited account (or document the trusted accounts).

title: EventBridge event bus policy does not allow public access (perimeter)
remediation: Remove wildcard principals or add restricting conditions to the event bus policy.

title: EventBridge global endpoint has event replication enabled
remediation: Enable event replication on the global endpoint so events reach the secondary Region.

title: EventBridge schema registry policy does not allow cross-account access
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0
remediation: Limit the schema registry policy to principals of the audited account.

title: CodeArtifact domain policy does not allow public access (perimeter)
remediation: Remove wildcard principals or add restricting conditions (organization, account, principal ARN) to the CodeArtifact permissions policy.

title: CodeArtifact repository policy does not allow public access (perimeter)
remediation: Remove wildcard principals or add restricting conditions (organization, account, principal ARN) to the CodeArtifact permissions policy.

title: Internal CodeArtifact packages block upstream (external) versions
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Set the package origin controls of internal packages to upstream=BLOCK to prevent dependency confusion.

title: CloudTrail trail S3 bucket has MFA Delete enabled
remediation: Enable versioning with MFA Delete on the CloudTrail log bucket (root credentials are required).

title: Account has at least one logging CloudTrail trail (home-region status)
remediation: Create a multi-Region CloudTrail trail and start logging.

title: No identity performed a burst of enumeration API calls in the activity window
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Investigate the identity's recent enumeration activity, rotate its credentials and restrict its permissions.

title: No identity performed a burst of Bedrock LLM-jacking API calls in the activity window
frameworks: NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Investigate the identity's recent Bedrock LLM-jacking activity, rotate its credentials and restrict its permissions.

title: No identity performed a burst of privilege-escalation API calls in the activity window
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Investigate the identity's recent privilege-escalation activity, rotate its credentials and restrict its permissions.

title: CloudWatch cross-account sharing role is absent (or reviewed)
remediation: Confirm the accounts trusted by CloudWatch-CrossAccountSharingRole are approved; delete the role if sharing is not needed.

title: CloudWatch log group is not exposed by a public Logs resource policy
frameworks: Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5
NIS2 - Network and Information Security Directive (Directive (EU) 2022/2555)
National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) v2.0
remediation: Restrict the CloudWatch Logs resource policy principals and resources so no log group is public.

title: CloudWatch Logs resource policy does not allow public access
remediation: Remove wildcard principals from the CloudWatch Logs resource policy or restrict them with source account/ARN conditions.

title: Config aggregation authorization is granted only to trusted accounts
remediation: Delete aggregation authorizations for accounts that are not approved aggregator accounts.

title: Config aggregator is an all-Region organization aggregator with a delegated administrator
remediation: Register a delegated administrator for config.amazonaws.com and use an organization aggregator with AllAwsRegions=true.

title: DLM EBS snapshot policy shares snapshots only with trusted accounts
remediation: Remove untrusted target accounts from DLM snapshot share rules.

remediation: Review analyzer configuration and its separate active state.

title: Role does not grant impersonation of users or service accounts
remediation: Remove impersonate on users/serviceaccounts except for vetted break-glass or proxy identities, and pin resourceNames.

title: ClusterRole does not grant impersonation of users or service accounts
remediation: Remove impersonate on users/serviceaccounts except for vetted break-glass or proxy identities, and pin resourceNames.

title: Role does not grant exec, attach, port-forward or ephemeral containers on pods
remediation: Restrict pods/exec, pods/attach, pods/portforward and pods/ephemeralcontainers to break-glass operators; regular users should not run commands inside workloads that hold ServiceAccount tokens or secrets.

title: ClusterRole does not grant exec, attach, port-forward or ephemeral containers on pods
remediation: Restrict pods/exec, pods/attach, pods/portforward and pods/ephemeralcontainers to break-glass operators; regular users should not run commands inside workloads that hold ServiceAccount tokens or secrets.

title: Role does not grant create/update/patch on workload controllers
remediation: Controller writes are equivalent to pod creation with any ServiceAccount of the namespace; grant them only to deployment pipelines/operators and enforce Pod Security Admission on the namespace.

title: ClusterRole does not grant create/update/patch on workload controllers
remediation: Controller writes are equivalent to pod creation with any ServiceAccount of the namespace; grant them only to deployment pipelines/operators and enforce Pod Security Admission on the namespace.

title: Role does not grant update/patch on services/status
remediation: Only cloud/load-balancer controllers should write services/status (CVE-2020-8554 interception); remove the grant from other roles.

title: ClusterRole does not grant update/patch on services/status
remediation: Only cloud/load-balancer controllers should write services/status (CVE-2020-8554 interception); remove the grant from other roles.

title: Service does not declare spec.externalIPs
remediation: Remove spec.externalIPs unless the address is administrator-owned and routed to the cluster; enable the DenyServiceExternalIPs admission plugin or an admission policy restricting the field (CVE-2020-8554).

title: Secret is not a long-lived legacy ServiceAccount token
remediation: Delete legacy kubernetes.io/service-account-token Secrets and use short-lived projected tokens (TokenRequest); legacy tokens never expire and stay valid until the Secret is deleted.

title: RoleBinding does not bind the system:anonymous user
remediation: Remove the system:anonymous subject; unauthenticated callers must not receive RBAC grants. Disable anonymous authentication or limit it to health endpoints.

title: ClusterRoleBinding does not bind the system:anonymous user
remediation: Remove the system:anonymous subject; unauthenticated callers must not receive RBAC grants. Disable anonymous authentication or limit it to health endpoints.

title: Cognito identity pool disables the basic (classic) authentication flow
remediation: Set AllowClassicFlow to false so credentials are only issued through the enhanced flow and its Cognito-applied scope-down policy.

title: Cognito app clients cannot write authorization-like custom attributes
remediation: Give each app client an explicit WriteAttributes allowlist excluding authorization-like custom claims such as plan; review signup and IdP mappings, reassert historical claims through trusted administration, and authorize from server-controlled data.

title: EKS cluster authenticates IAM principals through access entries, not only the aws-auth ConfigMap
remediation: Switch accessConfig.authenticationMode to API (or API_AND_CONFIG_MAP while migrating), move aws-auth mappings to access entries, and remove the hidden cluster-creator system:masters binding.

title: ECS cluster does not disable ECS Exec session logging
remediation: Set executeCommandConfiguration.logging to OVERRIDE with a CloudWatch Logs group or S3 bucket (or DEFAULT with awslogs task logging) so ECS Exec session transcripts are retained.

title: ECS task definition does not mount the container runtime socket or sensitive host paths
remediation: Remove host volumes for the Docker/containerd socket and host system paths; agents that need them (monitoring, logging) should run as vetted daemon services with read-only mounts.

title: SageMaker notebook instance requires IMDSv2
remediation: Set InstanceMetadataServiceConfiguration.MinimumInstanceMetadataServiceVersion to 2 so SSRF or code in the notebook cannot read the execution-role credentials with tokenless IMDSv1 requests.

title: Glue development endpoint has no public SSH address
remediation: Delete legacy Glue development endpoints or recreate them inside a VPC subnet with a restrictive security group; anyone with glue:UpdateDevEndpoint can install an SSH key and run code as the endpoint role.

title: AppSync GraphQL API does not accept API keys as an additional authorization mode
remediation: Remove API_KEY from additionalAuthenticationProviders (aws.c2b.appsync.graphql_no_api_key covers the default mode) and use IAM, Cognito, OIDC or Lambda authorization.

title: Lambda layer version policy is not public and grants no account outside the organization
remediation: Remove layer version permissions that use principal '*' without an aws:PrincipalOrgID condition or that name accounts outside the organization (RemoveLayerVersionPermission); layer code and any bundled secrets are readable by every grantee.

title: Lambda function runtime is not pinned with Manual runtime management
remediation: Set the runtime management configuration back to Auto (or FunctionUpdate) unless a documented rollback is in progress; Manual keeps the function on the selected runtime version indefinitely.

title: Lambda function has no environment variables named like literal credentials
remediation: Move passwords, private keys, client secrets and secret access keys out of Lambda environment variables into Secrets Manager or Parameter Store and read them at runtime with a narrowly scoped execution role; anyone with lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration / ListFunctions reads environment values in plaintext.

title: ECR registry policy is not public and grants no account outside the organization
remediation: Restrict the private registry policy (replication / pull-through cache permissions) to organization accounts or add an aws:PrincipalOrgID condition.

title: ECR replication only targets registries inside the organization
remediation: Remove replication rules whose destination registryId is outside the organization; cross-account replication copies every matching image to the destination registry.

title: ECR repository creation templates do not attach public or out-of-organization repository policies
remediation: Remove or rewrite repository creation templates whose repositoryPolicy grants '*' or accounts outside the organization; every repository later auto-created under the prefix inherits that policy.

title: EKS access entry principal belongs to the organization
remediation: Delete access entries whose principalArn belongs to an account outside the organization (DeleteAccessEntry) and review their associated access policies.

title: KMS grant on a customer managed key names no grantee outside the organization
remediation: Revoke grants (RevokeGrant / RetireGrant) whose GranteePrincipal belongs to an account outside the organization; grants are not shown in the key policy and keep working until revoked.

title: OpenSearch cross-cluster connection peers with a domain inside the organization
remediation: Delete or reject cross-cluster connections whose peer domain owner is outside the organization (DeleteOutboundConnection / RejectInboundConnection).

title: Cloud Run service does not run as the Compute Engine default service account
remediation: Run the workload as a dedicated user-managed service account holding only the roles it needs; the default service account often holds roles/editor on the project.

title: Cloud Run job does not run as the Compute Engine default service account
remediation: Run the workload as a dedicated user-managed service account holding only the roles it needs; the default service account often holds roles/editor on the project.

title: Cloud Run service sources credential-named environment variables from Secret Manager
remediation: Store credentials in Secret Manager and reference them with valueFrom.secretKeyRef (or a secret volume) instead of literal environment values readable by anyone with run.*.get.

title: Cloud Run job sources credential-named environment variables from Secret Manager
remediation: Store credentials in Secret Manager and reference them with valueFrom.secretKeyRef (or a secret volume) instead of literal environment values readable by anyone with run.*.get.

title: Cloud Function does not run as a default (App Engine or Compute Engine) service account
remediation: Run the workload as a dedicated user-managed service account holding only the roles it needs; the default service account often holds roles/editor on the project.

title: App Engine application does not run as the App Engine default service account
remediation: Run the workload as a dedicated user-managed service account holding only the roles it needs; the default service account often holds roles/editor on the project. Set the application-level serviceAccount (or per-version service accounts).

title: Instance template does not attach the default compute service account with the cloud-platform scope
remediation: Create a new template version with a user-managed service account and minimal scopes, and roll the managed instance groups to it; VMs created later from the template inherit its identity.

title: GKE node pools disable the insecure kubelet read-only port (10255)
remediation: Set insecureKubeletReadonlyPortEnabled=false on the cluster node-pool defaults (nodePoolDefaults / nodePoolAutoConfig for Autopilot) and on every node pool.

title: Project _Default log sink is not disabled
remediation: Re-enable the _Default sink (gcloud logging sinks update _Default --no-disabled) or document the aggregated organization/folder sink that replaces it; a disabled _Default sink stops routing non-audit logs.

title: Cloud KMS key keeps a destroy-scheduled window of at least 7 days
remediation: destroyScheduledDuration is immutable: create a replacement key with the default 30-day window, re-encrypt, and enforce constraints/cloudkms.minimumDestroyScheduledDuration.

title: Bucket default object ACL does not make new objects public
remediation: Enable uniform bucket-level access (or remove allUsers/allAuthenticatedUsers from the default object ACL); the bucket IAM policy does not show default-object-ACL grants.

title: Pub/Sub push subscription does not deliver to a raw IP or tunnel/request-capture host
remediation: Point push subscriptions at owned HTTPS endpoints (Cloud Run, Functions, owned domains) and enforce constraints/pubsub.allowedPushSubscriptionEndpoints.

title: Artifact Registry virtual repository gives private upstreams precedence over remote (public) upstreams
remediation: Give every standard (private) upstream a strictly higher priority than any remote upstream, or serve internal package names only from the private repository (dependency confusion).

title: Cloud Function sources credential-named environment variables from Secret Manager
remediation: Move credentials to Secret Manager and expose them with secretEnvironmentVariables / secret volumes instead of literal serviceConfig.environmentVariables readable by anyone with cloudfunctions.functions.get.

title: Pull-request Cloud Build trigger requires a /gcbrun comment or build approval
remediation: Set the pull-request comment control to 'Required' (or 'Required except for owners and collaborators') or enable approvalConfig.approvalRequired, so untrusted contributors cannot run a modified cloudbuild.yaml as the trigger's service account.

title: Cloud Build trigger runs as a dedicated service account, not a default build identity
remediation: Set the trigger serviceAccount to a dedicated least-privilege account; the legacy Cloud Build account and the Compute Engine default account frequently hold broad project roles, and every repository writer inherits them.

title: Active Cloud Storage HMAC key is recent and not bound to a default service account
remediation: Deactivate and delete HMAC keys older than 90 days or bound to default service accounts; enforce constraints/iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation, which also blocks new HMAC keys.

title: Cloud Composer environment does not run as the Compute Engine default service account
remediation: Run the workload as a dedicated user-managed service account holding only the roles it needs; the default service account often holds roles/editor on the project. Anyone who can write DAGs to the environment bucket runs code as this identity.

title: Vertex AI Workbench instance does not run as the Compute Engine default service account
remediation: Run the workload as a dedicated user-managed service account holding only the roles it needs; the default service account often holds roles/editor on the project. Notebook, terminal and startup-script code all use the attached account's credentials.

title: Cloud Scheduler job does not replay IAM/key/firewall writes as a service account
remediation: Review and delete scheduled jobs that call setIamPolicy, create service-account or HMAC keys, firewall rules or bucket ACL/IAM changes with an OAuth token: they re-create access on a schedule and survive removal of the original grant.

title: Effective org policy blocks service-account key creation and key upload
remediation: Enforce constraints/iam.managed.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation and iam.managed.disableServiceAccountKeyUpload (or their legacy booleans) at the organization and avoid project-level overrides; exported or uploaded keys are long-lived backdoors for the service account.

title: Effective org policy keeps cross-project service-account attachment disabled
remediation: Set an explicit enforce:true policy for iam.disableCrossProjectServiceAccountUsage at the organization (the secure-by-default policy exists only on organizations created on or after 2024-05-03); when a shared deployer account is required, scope the exception to that single project.

title: Effective org policy stops automatic Editor grants to new default service accounts
remediation: Enforce iam.managed.preventPrivilegedBasicRolesForDefaultServiceAccounts or iam.automaticIamGrantsForDefaultServiceAccounts and remove roles/editor from existing default service accounts.

title: Effective org policy restricts IAM members to allowed domains (Domain Restricted Sharing)
remediation: Enforce iam.managed.allowedPolicyMembers or iam.allowedPolicyMemberDomains (allowed customer IDs/principal sets) so allUsers, allAuthenticatedUsers and external accounts cannot be bound to project resources.

title: Effective org policy restricts Essential Contacts to allowed domains
remediation: Enforce essentialcontacts.managed.allowedContactDomains or essentialcontacts.allowedContactDomains with the organization's domains so an attacker cannot register an external address that receives security notifications.

title: Service account IAM policy does not grant roles to a whole workload identity pool
remediation: Bind a specific mapped identity (principal://.../subject/... or principalSet://.../attribute.repository/ORG/REPO) instead of the pool-wide principalSet://.../workloadIdentityPools/POOL/*, and gate every provider with an attributeCondition; otherwise any identity any current or future provider admits receives the role.

title: Project/folder/organization IAM policy does not grant roles to a whole workload identity pool
remediation: Bind a specific mapped identity (principal://.../subject/... or principalSet://.../attribute.repository/ORG/REPO) instead of the pool-wide principalSet://.../workloadIdentityPools/POOL/*, and gate every provider with an attributeCondition; otherwise any identity any current or future provider admits receives the role.

title: Bucket Pub/Sub notification publishes to a topic in the bucket's own project
remediation: Review notification configs that publish object events to topics in other projects and delete unknown ones (gcloud storage buckets notifications list/delete); each event names the object and can trigger exfiltration.

title: Event Hubs namespace disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: Event Grid topic disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: Event Grid domain disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: SignalR service disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: Web PubSub service disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: App Configuration store disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: AI Search service disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: IoT Hub (hub-level shared access policies) disables local (key/SAS) authentication
remediation: Set properties.disableLocalAuth=true so the data plane only accepts Microsoft Entra ID tokens governed by Azure RBAC; keys obtained through listKeys-style actions then stop working.

title: Azure Cache for Redis disables access-key authentication
remediation: Enable Microsoft Entra authentication and set disableAccessKeyAuthentication=true so listKeys output no longer authenticates to the cache data plane.

title: Batch account does not allow SharedKey data-plane authentication
remediation: Remove SharedKey from allowedAuthenticationModes (keep AAD / TaskAuthenticationToken); account keys let any holder submit tasks that run commands on pool nodes.

title: Container registry does not allow anonymous (unauthenticated) pull
remediation: Set anonymousPullEnabled=false unless the registry is intentionally public; anonymous pull exposes every repository in the registry to unauthenticated clients.

title: Key Vault does not let ARM template deployments retrieve its secrets
remediation: Set enabledForTemplateDeployment=false unless the vault deliberately serves ARM/Bicep secret references; with it enabled, Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/deploy/action reveals secrets without any data-plane permission.

title: SQL server with a Microsoft Entra administrator enforces Entra-only authentication
remediation: Enable Microsoft Entra-only authentication so SQL logins (and a reset administrator password) cannot be used.

title: PostgreSQL flexible server disables password authentication
remediation: Set authConfig.passwordAuth=Disabled with Microsoft Entra authentication enabled, so resetting the administrator password through ARM no longer yields database access.

title: Storage account does not expose SFTP local-user access
remediation: Disable SFTP (isSftpEnabled=false) or local users (isLocalUserEnabled=false) when not required; SFTP local-user passwords/keys are credentials outside Entra ID and are not blocked by allowSharedKeyAccess=false.

title: Logic App HTTP request trigger restricts callers beyond the SAS callback URL
remediation: Add accessControl.triggers.allowedCallerIpAddresses or an OAuth (Entra ID) authorization policy for Request triggers; otherwise anyone holding the signed callback URL can invoke the workflow from anywhere.

title: Application registration does not request tier-0 Microsoft Graph application permissions
remediation: Replace tier-0 Graph application permissions (RoleManagement/AppRoleAssignment/Application/Directory ReadWrite...) with least-privileged or delegated permissions, restrict who can add credentials to the app, and review its owners.

title: Temporary Access Pass, when enabled, is one-time use with a short maximum lifetime
remediation: Set the TemporaryAccessPass method configuration to isUsableOnce=true and keep maximumLifetimeInMinutes at or below 480; a reusable long-lived TAP issued through UserAuthenticationMethod.ReadWrite.All is a durable sign-in for any user.

title: App Service SCM (Kudu) site does not accept basic-auth publishing credentials
remediation: Set basicPublishingCredentialsPolicies/scm allow=false; deploy with Microsoft Entra identities. Publishing credentials (publishxml/config list) then no longer authenticate Kudu deployment and command endpoints.

title: App Service with FTP(S) enabled does not accept basic-auth FTP publishing credentials
remediation: Set basicPublishingCredentialsPolicies/ftp allow=false, or disable FTP entirely (ftpsState=Disabled); FTP publishing credentials let any holder replace the deployed code.

title: App Service with main-site access restrictions also restricts its SCM (Kudu) site
remediation: Set scmIpSecurityRestrictionsUseMain=true or define SCM access restrictions with a Deny default; otherwise the Kudu deployment/command endpoint stays reachable from anywhere while the app itself is restricted.

title: Non-SAML service principal object carries no active password credential
remediation: Remove password credentials from the service principal object (they are not shown with the app registration) and enable app instance property lock; issue credentials on the owning app registration or use managed/federated identity.

title: Application federated credential does not trust GitHub pull_request workflows
remediation: Scope the GitHub subject to a protected environment (environment:<name> with required reviewers) or a protected branch/tag ref instead of pull_request, so only reviewed workflows can mint Entra tokens for this identity.

title: Managed identity federated credential does not trust GitHub pull_request workflows
remediation: Scope the GitHub subject to a protected environment (environment:<name> with required reviewers) or a protected branch/tag ref instead of pull_request, so only reviewed workflows can mint Entra tokens for this identity.

title: Enabled Automation webhooks expire within one year of the snapshot
remediation: Delete unused webhooks and recreate needed ones with short expiries; a webhook URI is an anonymous trigger that runs its runbook as the account's identity until it expires.

title: Synapse workspace IP firewall has no Internet-wide allow rule
remediation: Remove 0.0.0.0-255.255.255.255 (AllowAll) firewall rules and allow only specific client ranges, or disable public network access and use private endpoints.

title: A logging multi-Region CloudTrail trail records read and write management events
remediation: Create (or fix) a multi-Region trail that is logging and records All (read and write) management events.

title: Firewall TCP ingress allows only the IAP proxy and Google health-check ranges
remediation: Restrict TCP ingress source ranges to the IAP proxy range 35.235.240.0/20 and the Google health-check ranges 130.211.0.0/22 and 35.191.0.0/16, and delete default-allow-http/https/internal (CIS GCP 3.10); see https://cloud.google.com/iap/docs/using-tcp-forwarding#create-firewall-rule

title: Cloud SQL SQL Server trace flag 3625 is 'off' (literal CIS GCP v1.2/v1.3 6.3.6)
remediation: Only for CIS GCP v1.2.0/v1.3.0 6.3.6 literal compliance: set database flag 3625 to 'off'. CIS GCP v2.0+ reversed this recommendation; the security-preferred setting is 'on' (3625 masks error-message parameters for non-sysadmin users), see gcp.ports.sql_instance_sql_3625_trace_database_flag_on.
